themes.consensus_view: Four desks are watching the hyperscalers (the giant cloud companies like Amazon, Microsoft and Google) from several angles at once, including their capital spending pace, data-center demand, earnings sentiment, and a widening in their credit default swaps (the cost of insuring their debt, which rises when investors get nervous), but no bank has staked a directional call yet.

facts_agreed.claim: Four banks flag hyperscaler activity as a live subject this window, referencing capital spending plans, data-center demand, earnings sentiment, and widening credit protection costs without taking a directional stance.
